description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Samarakoon Mudiyanselage Manoj Sanjeewa Samarakoon as a Member of the Minipe P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Minipe Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) as it pertains to electoral processes and declarations.
